legend: Left: In the absence of the hedgehog (Hh) ligands, hedgehog receptor PTCH inhibits SMO signalling via an unknown mechanism. GLI molecules are processed into repressor forms (GLIR), which turn off the hedgehog signalling pathway. Right: In the presence of hedgehog, PTCH is unable to inhibit SMO. SMO undergoes conformational changes and is localized to the cilium. GLI molecules are now processed to active forms (GLIA), which will activate the hedgehog target genes.
